tool.name: AddOvertureTaxonomyCodeFields
tool.summary: Add Overture taxonomy code fields to a feature class based on the primary category. Maps each primary_category value to its corresponding taxonomy hierarchy and populates separate fields for each taxonomy level.

usage.bullet_item: The input features should already have a primary_category field populated, typically by running the Add Primary Category Field tool first.
This tool is designed for Overture place features.

param.name: input_features
param.dialogReference: The feature layer or feature class containing a primary_category field to use for taxonomy code lookups.
